extra_vocab.en: the buying and selling of goods and services
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 online commerce platform 指線上購物或電商平台。commerce 比 business 更強調「買賣交易」本身，常見於電商相關的文章。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: commerce 是不可數名詞，不加 s，也不加 a。

example.en: E-commerce sales grew by twenty percent during the holiday season.
example.zh: 電子商務的銷售額在假期期間成長了兩成。

example.en: The local chamber of commerce will host a networking event.
example.zh: 當地商會將舉辦一場交流活動。

example.en: Online commerce has changed how small shops reach customers.
example.zh: 線上商務改變了小商店接觸顧客的方式。

examples.en: International commerce slowed after the new tax rules took effect.
examples.zh: 新稅制生效後，國際貿易趨緩。

examples.en: Our company specializes in software for mobile commerce.
examples.zh: 我們公司專門開發行動商務的軟體。

examples.en: The Department of Commerce released its annual trade report today.
examples.zh: 商務部今天發布了年度貿易報告。

confusable.diff: commence 是動詞，意思是「開始」（正式用法），拼法和 commerce 很像但意思完全不同。
confusable.usage: commerce 是名詞（商業），commence 是動詞（開始），後者常見於正式通知，如 The meeting will commence at nine。

example.en: The training session will commence at nine o'clock sharp.
example.zh: 訓練課程將在九點整開始。

similar.diff: trade 常指國與國之間或業者之間的貨物買賣；commerce 範圍更廣，包含整體商業活動。

example.en: Trade between the two countries has increased this year.
example.zh: 兩國之間的貿易今年有所增加。

similar.diff: business 是最通用的「生意、公司」；commerce 較正式，強調買賣交易。

example.en: Her business sells handmade furniture to customers overseas.
example.zh: 她的生意把手工家具賣給海外顧客。

example.en: Free trade helps small companies sell their products abroad.
example.zh: 自由貿易幫助小公司把產品賣到國外。

example.en: She has ten years of experience in retail management.
example.zh: 她有十年的零售管理經驗。

example.en: Each transaction is recorded in the system automatically.
example.zh: 每一筆交易都會自動記錄在系統中。

derived.link: commerce 去掉 -e 加 -ial，變形容詞「商業的」，像 office → official
commercial + -ly，形容詞變副詞，像 quick → quickly

extra_vocab.en: a mistake in a computer program that makes it work wrongly
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 a software bug 指造成顧客重複扣款的程式錯誤。bug 是資訊相關文章的高頻字，比 error 更口語，也更偏向「程式本身的缺陷」。

example.en: The testers found several bugs in the latest version of the app.
example.zh: 測試人員在最新版本的應用程式中找到數個錯誤。

example.en: Our engineers worked all night to fix a bug in the payment page.
example.zh: 我們的工程師徹夜工作，修正付款頁面的錯誤。

example.en: A software bug deleted some files from the customer database.
example.zh: 一個軟體錯誤刪除了客戶資料庫中的部分檔案。

example.en: Please attach a screenshot when you submit a bug report.
example.zh: 提交錯誤回報時，請附上螢幕截圖。

examples.en: The bug only appears when users pay with a credit card.
examples.zh: 這個錯誤只有在使用者以信用卡付款時才會出現。

examples.en: We apologize for the bug and have already released a patch.
examples.zh: 我們為這個錯誤致歉，並且已經發布修補程式。

examples.en: Customers reported a bug that prevented them from logging in.
examples.zh: 顧客回報有個錯誤讓他們無法登入。

similar.diff: glitch 是暫時性的小故障，可能自己消失；bug 是程式本身的缺陷，要修改程式才會好。

example.en: A brief glitch interrupted the live video stream this morning.
example.zh: 今早一個短暫的小故障中斷了直播串流。

similar.diff: defect 通常指產品或設備的瑕疵，bug 專指軟體。

example.en: The inspector found a defect in the battery pack.
example.zh: 檢驗員在電池組中發現了瑕疵。

example.en: An error message appeared when I tried to save the file.
example.zh: 我嘗試存檔時出現了錯誤訊息。

example.en: Any defect must be reported within seven days of delivery.
example.zh: 任何瑕疵都必須在到貨後七天內回報。

example.en: The company released a security patch on Friday evening.
example.zh: 公司在星期五晚上發布了一個安全修補程式。

senses.en: a mistake in a computer program
senses.distinguish: 文中有 software、engineers、corrected the error，判斷是程式問題。

example.en: The new update fixed a bug that slowed down the website.
example.zh: 新的更新修正了讓網站變慢的錯誤。

senses.distinguish: 和農業、食品、環境清潔等情境一起出現。

example.en: The restaurant was closed after inspectors found bugs in the kitchen.
example.zh: 檢查人員在廚房發現小蟲後，這家餐廳被勒令停業。

senses.en: a mild illness that spreads easily
senses.distinguish: 常寫成 a stomach bug 或 catch a bug，出現在請病假的情境。

example.en: Half the office stayed home because of a stomach bug.
example.zh: 辦公室有一半的人因為腸胃型感冒待在家。

extra_vocab.en: to make ideas or feelings known to someone
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 convey a sincere apology 指把誠摯的歉意傳達給顧客。convey 比 say 或 give 更正式，常用於道歉、感謝、訊息，是客氣得體的書面用語。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: convey 的句型是 convey + 事物 + to + 人，不能說 convey someone something；例如 convey our thanks to the team。

example.en: The logo conveys a sense of trust and quality.
example.zh: 這個標誌傳達出信賴與品質的感覺。

example.en: She conveyed the client's concerns to the project team.
example.zh: 她把客戶的疑慮傳達給專案團隊。

example.en: Conveying bad news in person shows respect to the customer.
example.zh: 當面傳達壞消息是對顧客的尊重。

example.en: The poster should convey a message that is clear and simple.
example.zh: 海報應該傳達清楚又簡單的訊息。

example.en: Please convey our thanks to everyone who joined the event.
example.zh: 請向所有參加活動的人轉達我們的謝意。

example.en: Charts help us convey information to the board quickly.
example.zh: 圖表幫助我們快速向董事會傳達資訊。

examples.en: I would like to convey my sincere apology for the delay.
examples.zh: 我想為延遲一事表達我誠摯的歉意。

examples.en: A good presentation conveys complex ideas in simple language.
examples.zh: 好的簡報用簡單的語言傳達複雜的概念。

examples.en: A belt conveys the boxes from the warehouse to the trucks.
examples.zh: 輸送帶把箱子從倉庫運到卡車上。

confusable.diff: convince 是「說服、使相信」，後面接人；convey 是「傳達」，後面接訊息或感受。
confusable.usage: convince + 人 + of / that，如 convince the client that…；convey + 事物 + to + 人。

example.en: Her report convinced the board to approve the new budget.
example.zh: 她的報告說服董事會核准了新預算。

confusable.diff: convene 是「召集、召開（會議）」，和傳達訊息無關。

example.en: The committee will convene on Monday to review the proposals.
example.zh: 委員會將在星期一召開會議審查提案。

similar.diff: communicate 是溝通，可不接受詞（communicate with 人）；convey 一定要接被傳達的內容。

example.en: We communicate with our overseas clients by email every day.
example.zh: 我們每天用電子郵件與海外客戶溝通。

similar.diff: express 強調把自己的感受說出來；convey 強調讓對方收到並理解。

example.en: Several customers expressed concern about the new fees.
example.zh: 幾位顧客對新的費用表示擔憂。

example.en: He expressed his thanks to the whole sales team.
example.zh: 他向整個業務團隊表達謝意。

example.en: Please deliver this message to the manager today.
example.zh: 請今天把這則訊息轉交給經理。

example.en: Trucks transport the goods to stores across the country.
example.zh: 卡車把貨物運到全國各地的商店。

derived.link: convey + -or，做事的東西或人，像 operator、visitor；常見於 conveyor belt（輸送帶）

senses.en: to let someone know an idea or a feeling
senses.distinguish: 受詞是 apology、message、thanks 等抽象的東西。

example.en: The manager conveyed his concerns to the head office.
example.zh: 經理向總公司傳達了他的疑慮。

senses.en: to carry people or things from one place to another
senses.distinguish: 受詞是貨物、水、電等實物，主詞常是輸送帶或管線。

example.en: The pipeline conveys oil from the port to the refinery.
example.zh: 這條管線把石油從港口輸送到煉油廠。

extra_vocab.en: needing careful handling because it could easily go wrong
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 the matter remains delicate 表示重複扣款一事仍然敏感，溝通時稍有不慎就會讓顧客不滿，所以要求同仁使用核准的訊息範本。

example.en: We are in a delicate situation after the contract dispute.
example.zh: 合約爭議之後，我們處於微妙的處境。

example.en: Salary is a delicate matter that should be discussed in private.
example.zh: 薪資是敏感的事，應該私下討論。

example.en: Managers must keep a delicate balance between cost and quality.
example.zh: 經理必須在成本與品質之間保持微妙的平衡。

examples.en: The negotiation is at a delicate stage, so please stay quiet.
examples.zh: 談判正處於微妙的階段，所以請保持安靜。

examples.en: Delicate equipment must be packed in special boxes for shipping.
examples.zh: 精密設備必須用特製的箱子包裝運送。

examples.en: This is a delicate issue, so I will call you directly.
examples.zh: 這是敏感的問題，所以我會直接打電話給你。

confusable.diff: delicious 是「美味的」，拼法開頭相近但意思和 delicate 完全不同。

example.en: The caterer prepared a delicious lunch for all of the guests.
example.zh: 外燴業者為所有賓客準備了美味的午餐。

similar.diff: sensitive 強調「容易引起情緒反應」的議題；delicate 強調「需要小心處理」。

example.en: Customer data is sensitive, so only a few staff can see it.
example.zh: 顧客資料屬於敏感資訊，所以只有少數員工能看到。

similar.diff: tricky 是口語的「棘手、不好處理」，delicate 更正式、帶有需要技巧與禮貌的意味。

example.en: Scheduling a meeting across three time zones is tricky.
example.zh: 安排橫跨三個時區的會議很棘手。

example.en: Mark every box fragile before it goes onto the truck.
example.zh: 貨物上卡車前，請在每個箱子上標示易碎。

example.en: Use a gentle tone when you speak to upset customers.
example.zh: 和不開心的顧客說話時，請用溫和的語氣。

example.en: Be careful when you handle the original contract.
example.zh: 處理合約正本時請小心。

derived.link: delicate 的 -ate 換成 -acy，變成抽象名詞，像 accurate → accuracy
delicate + -ly，形容詞變副詞，像 careful → carefully

senses.en: needing careful handling so that nothing goes wrong
senses.distinguish: 主詞是 matter、situation、issue 等抽象的事。

example.en: Layoffs are a delicate issue for any growing company.
example.zh: 裁員對任何成長中的公司都是敏感的議題。

senses.distinguish: 主詞是儀器、布料、零件等實物。

example.en: The delicate parts were wrapped in soft paper before shipping.
example.zh: 精密的零件在出貨前用軟紙包好。

senses.en: light and soft in color, taste, or smell
senses.distinguish: 常修飾 color、flavor、scent，帶正面的感覺。

example.en: The hotel lobby has a delicate scent of fresh flowers.
example.zh: 飯店大廳有淡淡的鮮花香氣。
